statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation as the underlying etiology
The service was ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period
The service aims to guide appropriate anticoagulation and rate control management
There is high risk of thromboembolic complications
The associated diagnoses are G45.9, I48.91, and R00.2
The claim was denied based on reason code CO-197
The denial was because required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to the service date
